market_pulse.note: Around $73,000 late Tuesday morning, down about 2.3%–2.7% over 24 hours after the hot CPI report; it hit an intraday low near $72,787, its lowest since Aug. 21.
About $2.49 trillion as of 1 a.m. ET Tuesday (CoinCodex), before the CPI-driven selloff that pushed most major tokens lower.
About 60.5% as of 1 a.m. ET Tuesday (CoinCodex).

themes.title: Hot CPI pushes Bitcoin to an 11-week low
themes.summary: October consumer prices rose 0.4% versus 0.3% expected; Bitcoin slipped from about $74,300 before the release to below $73,000 as December rate-hike odds firmed.

themes.title: ETF outflows keep building
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs lost about $201 million on Monday, bringing outflows since Nov. 2 to roughly $1.5 billion; BlackRock's IBIT has seen seven straight days of redemptions, and spot Ether ETFs lost about $185 million.

themes.title: Miner selling adds supply
themes.summary: MARA Holdings sold 13,597 BTC, about $1.1 billion, over six weeks and has said it plans to sell more.

themes.title: Long positions liquidated
themes.summary: More than $632 million in crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours, about $511 million of them longs, per Coinglass data.

themes.title: NYSE picks Avalanche for tokenized trading
themes.summary: The NYSE chose Avalanche to settle trades on a planned 24/7 tokenized securities platform, lifting AVAX about 5% before the CPI release.

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Both fell after the CPI report, with Ether (down about 5%) dropping more than Bitcoin (down about 2.5%).

categories.name: Tokenized assets / RWA
categories.note: Traders rotated toward real-world-asset tokens early Tuesday; XDC Network led the CoinDesk 100, up about 7% since midnight UTC.

categories.name: Privacy coins
categories.note: Among the weakest groups, with Monero down about 7.8% and Zcash down about 6.3% over 24 hours.

categories.name: Memecoins
categories.note: The CoinDesk Memecoin Index was up about 0.4% early Tuesday, before the post-CPI decline.

watch_list.why: After the CPI report, futures price about 85% odds of a quarter-point hike and about 15% odds of a half-point hike; rate expectations have weighed on crypto.
Market reports flag $73,000–$73,500 as near-term support; Tuesday's low was the weakest level since late August.
Continued redemptions from spot ETFs and further selling by miners such as MARA would add supply to the market.

movers.name: Pieverse (PIEVERSE)
movers.note: Among the day's top performers, up about 30% (CoinDesk, early Tuesday).

movers.name: Gram (GRAM, formerly Toncoin)
movers.note: Top 24-hour gainer in CoinCodex's 1 a.m. ET snapshot.

movers.name: Midnight (NIGHT)
movers.note: Second-largest gainer in CoinCodex's 1 a.m. ET snapshot.

movers.name: Avalanche (AVAX)
movers.note: Up about 5% after the NYSE tokenized-trading news (CoinDesk, early Tuesday).

movers.name: Zcash (ZEC)
movers.note: Privacy coins lagged as traders rotated into real-world-asset tokens (CoinDesk).

movers.name: Monero (XMR)
movers.note: Among the weakest large tokens over 24 hours (CoinDesk).
